stories.headline: Trump and Putin to meet one-on-one in China
body: Trump will hold a one-on-one meeting with Putin in China on Thursday, a US official says.
They last met in Alaska in August 2025 without a deal on Ukraine.
US envoys are also meeting Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin.
stories.vc: Any Ukraine breakthrough would move energy and defence stocks.

stories.headline: Hegseth announces US military partnership with Venezuela
body: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth made a surprise visit to Caracas.
He announced a deal with Venezuela's interim government on joint training and intelligence sharing.
He is the latest senior Trump official to visit.
stories.vc: Closer ties could reopen Venezuela's oil sector to US firms.

stories.headline: US lawmakers push a $25 minimum wage and end to tipped pay
body: A group of 17 lawmakers is pushing the Living Wage For All Act.
It would raise the federal minimum wage to $25 and end the lower 'tipped' wage.
78% of voters called the minimum wage an important election issue.
stories.vc: Restaurants and retailers would face higher labour costs.

stories.headline: Bengaluru's Jakkur rail overbridge opens after 15 years
body: The 443-metre Jakkur railway overbridge in north Bengaluru is finally complete.
It should ease traffic between Jakkur and Yelahanka.
CM D.K. Shivakumar was set to open it, and launch new flyover work.
stories.joke: Fifteen years: a bridge, and a whole childhood.
stories.vc: Better roads help north Bengaluru's housing and airport corridor.

stories.headline: PB Fintech cofounder Alok Bansal to step down from executive role
body: Policybazaar parent PB Fintech says cofounder Alok Bansal will leave his executive role on March 31, 2027.
He will move to the board, subject to shareholder approval.
Cofounders of Unacademy, BigBasket and Setu also stepped back this year.
stories.vc: Founder exits test how well listed startups plan succession.

stories.headline: Xiaomi faces fresh tax scrutiny over royalty payments
body: The Centre says Xiaomi India and ex-manufacturer Flex didn't fully disclose royalty deals.
The question is whether 2–5% royalties count in import values for customs duty.
The Supreme Court case could affect other contract manufacturers.
stories.joke: Royalty, but not the fun kind.
stories.vc: The ruling could change costs for phone makers that import parts.

stories.headline: Banks say customers using AI agents are on their own
body: Citibank says customers who let third-party AI tools access their accounts bear the risk, even if hacked.
AI agents can be given bank logins to analyse spending or pay bills.
More banks are taking a similar line.
stories.vc: Liability rules will shape how fast AI money assistants catch on.

stories.headline: An 'SNL' skit shows who really cares for ageing parents: daughters
body: An SNL sketch mocked how elder care falls mostly on daughters.
Women are the majority of unpaid caregivers for ageing parents, often at big career cost.
Some lawmakers see a chance for policy change.
stories.vc: Unpaid care pushes women out of work, a hit to the economy.
